summary: Annovis Bio filed a Rule 424(b)(5) prospectus supplement for a marketed follow-on offering of 19,000,000 common shares (plus up to 2,000,000 pre-funded warrants in lieu) bundled with 21,000,000 warrants. Combined price is $1.00 per share and warrant; pre-funded units price at $0.9999 with a $0.0001 exercise price. Gross proceeds total roughly $20.9998 million, with underwriting discounts of about $1.2 million and net proceeds near $19.8 million. Warrants carry a $1.00 strike, expire in five years, and are unlisted. Last sale was $1.09 on November 3, 2026; a director is buying 5,000,000 shares.
